## Project Overview

This bachelor thesis investigates the **numerical stability** of functional MRI (fMRI) connectivity biomarkers. It reproduces the results of *Alizadeh et al. 2025* ([biorxiv](https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.64898/2025.12.22.695524)), which introduces the Numerical-Population Variability Ratio (NPVR), first through a synthetic simulation, then for functional connectivity (FC) matrices and graph-theoretical metrics by perturbing the entire [fMRIPrep](https://fmriprep.org/){target="_blank"} preprocessing pipeline with a custom `fuzzy-fmriprep` Docker container built on [Verificarlo](https://github.com/verificarlo/verificarlo){target="_blank"} and the [Fuzzy](https://github.com/verificarlo/fuzzy){target="_blank"} libmath library.

It then extends this work in two directions: examining FC matrix edge NPVR directly, and assessing the numerical stability of the PCA-based feature extraction introduced by *Yamashita et al. 2026* ([doi:10.1162/IMAG.a.1121](https://doi.org/10.1162/IMAG.a.1121){target="_blank"}) by perturbing the `np.corrcoef` function used to build the FC matrices and forcing the PCA inputs to 32-bit floating-point precision.

The project is organized around four interactive [Marimo](https://marimo.io/){target="_blank"} notebooks in [`bachelor-thesis-project/notebooks/`](https://github.com/MadeInShineA/bachelor-thesis-project/tree/main/notebooks){target="_blank"}:

1. **NPVR Simulation**:  Creates a synthetic simulation exploring how sample size and numerical-to-population variability ratios affect NPVR and Cohen's _d_.

2. **Fuzzy fMRIPrep Graph Metrics Analysis**: Generates FC matrices from fuzzy-fMRIPrep outputs, thresholds them, and computes local and global graph metrics, then resolves the NPVR across Monte Carlo repetitions.

3. **Fuzzy fMRIPrep FC Matrices Analysis**: Focuses on the FC matrices themselves, computing edge-wise NPVR and comparing confound-regression strategies through heatmaps, scatter plots, histograms, and regional brain maps.

4. **Fuzzy PCA Dimensionality Reduction Analysis**: Reproduces and extends a PCA-based feature-selection pipeline on the SRPB and BMB public datasets, linking FC features to diagnosis (HC vs. MDD), age, BDI, sex, site, and motion. It perturbs FC matrix extraction (`np.corrcoef`) and forces PCA inputs to 32-bit floating-point, then compares regular vs. fuzzy PCA feature-selection results with consensus maps and a robustness analysis.

Together, these notebooks provide a systematic exploration of numerical variability at successive stages of the fMRI connectivity analysis pipeline.
